credit_ledger_job_step_charge_uq.name: credit_ledger_job_step_charge_uq
credit_ledger_job_step_charge_uq.where: reason = 'charge' and step_key is not null

email_sends_lengths_check.name: email_sends_lengths_check
email_sends_lengths_check.value:
char_length("email_sends"."template") between 1 and 40
        and char_length("email_sends"."dedupe_key") between 1 and 200
        and char_length(coalesce("email_sends"."provider_id", '')) <= 100
        and char_length(coalesce("email_sends"."error", '')) <= 500
        and "email_sends"."attempts" >= 1

ops_audit_lengths_check.name: ops_audit_lengths_check
ops_audit_lengths_check.value: char_length("ops_audit"."operator_email") between 3 and 320 and char_length("ops_audit"."action") between 1 and 64 and char_length("ops_audit"."target_kind") between 1 and 64 and char_length(coalesce("ops_audit"."target_id", '')) <= 200

pack_cases_shot_length.name: pack_cases_shot_length
pack_cases_shot_length.value: "pack_cases"."shot_id" IS NULL OR char_length("pack_cases"."shot_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 160

pack_claims_claim_check.name: pack_claims_claim_check
pack_claims_claim_check.value: "pack_claims"."claimed_by_workspace_id" is null or "pack_claims"."claimed_at" is not null

retired_source_objects_workspace_key.name: retired_source_objects_workspace_key
retired_source_objects_workspace_key.value: starts_with("retired_source_objects"."r2_key", 'ws/' || "retired_source_objects"."workspace_id"::text || '/') AND length("retired_source_objects"."r2_key") > length('ws/' || "retired_source_objects"."workspace_id"::text || '/') AND position('..' in "retired_source_objects"."r2_key") = 0 AND position(chr(92) in "retired_source_objects"."r2_key") = 0 AND octet_length("retired_source_objects"."r2_key") <= 1024

signup_attributions_lengths_check.name: signup_attributions_lengths_check
signup_attributions_lengths_check.value:
char_length(coalesce("signup_attributions"."self_reported", '')) <= 40
        and char_length(coalesce("signup_attributions"."self_reported_other", '')) <= 80
        and char_length(coalesce("signup_attributions"."source", '')) <= 40
        and char_length(coalesce("signup_attributions"."utm_source", '')) <= 100
        and char_length(coalesce("signup_attributions"."utm_medium", '')) <= 100
        and char_length(coalesce("signup_attributions"."utm_campaign", '')) <= 100
        and char_length(coalesce("signup_attributions"."utm_content", '')) <= 100
        and char_length(coalesce("signup_attributions"."utm_term", '')) <= 100
        and char_length(coalesce("signup_attributions"."ref", '')) <= 32
        and char_length(coalesce("signup_attributions"."share_slug", '')) <= 32
        and char_length(coalesce("signup_attributions"."claim_id", '')) <= 64
        and char_length(coalesce("signup_attributions"."preview_id", '')) <= 36
        and char_length(coalesce("signup_attributions"."landing_path", '')) <= 200
        and char_length(coalesce("signup_attributions"."referrer_host", '')) <= 100

signup_grants_paid_email_key_uq.name: signup_grants_paid_email_key_uq
signup_grants_paid_email_key_uq.where: credits > 0 and email_key is not null

webhook_deliveries_lease.name: webhook_deliveries_lease
webhook_deliveries_lease.value: ("webhook_deliveries"."status" = 'leased') = ("webhook_deliveries"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "webhook_deliveries"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

webhook_endpoints_key_length.name: webhook_endpoints_key_length
webhook_endpoints_key_length.value: char_length("webhook_endpoints"."key_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND char_length("webhook_endpoints"."encrypted_secret") BETWEEN 1 AND 4096

webhook_endpoints_activation.name: webhook_endpoints_activation
webhook_endpoints_activation.value: NOT "webhook_endpoints"."enabled" OR ("webhook_endpoints"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL AND "webhook_endpoints"."revoked_at" IS NULL)

workspace_credit_budget_audit_limits.name: workspace_credit_budget_audit_limits
workspace_credit_budget_audit_limits.value: ("workspace_credit_budget_audit"."prior_limit" IS NULL OR ("workspace_credit_budget_audit"."prior_limit" >= 0 AND "workspace_credit_budget_audit"."prior_limit" <= 1000000000)) AND ("workspace_credit_budget_audit"."new_limit" IS NULL OR ("workspace_credit_budget_audit"."new_limit" >= 0 AND "workspace_credit_budget_audit"."new_limit" <= 1000000000))
